arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Merrill Lynch contends the statutory language creates a straightforward test for federal jurisdiction.
Manning argues that state law claims do not seek redress under federal law.
Justice Sotomayor questioned how state law causes of action seek federal redress.
Justice Roberts asked if the plaintiffs are merely alleging fraud under state law.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on whether federal courts hold exclusive jurisdiction over securities fraud claims. the sides that brought the case seek to remove the case to federal court. the opposing sides want to keep the case in state court.

paragraphs: Merrill Lynch argues Exchange Act Section 27 grants federal courts exclusive jurisdiction over enforcement suits.
Manning argues jurisdictional statutes should not intrude on state authority without clear congressional intent.
